result.topic_en: The page states that if a number A, or a multiple of it, can be represented by the cubic norm form x^3+ny^3+n^2z^3-3nxyz, then n is a cubic residue of A, and it gives three equivalent expressions for the cube root of n modulo A.
result.transcription:
Wenn eine Zahl $A$ oder ein Vielfaches derselben
in der Form
$x^3+ny^3+nnz^3-3nxyz$
enthalten ist, so ist $n$ ein kubischer Rest von $A$
und der Werth des Ausdrucks
$\sqrt[3]{n}\ (\mathrm{mod}\ A) \equiv \frac{xx-nyz}{nzz-xy} \equiv \frac{nyy-nxz}{xx-nyz} \equiv \frac{nzz-xy}{yy-xz}$

methods.what: Criterion for cubic residuacity: if A divides a value of the cubic norm form x^3+ny^3+n^2z^3-3nxyz, then n is a cubic residue mod A

items.english: If a number A or a multiple of it is contained in the form x^3+ny^3+nnz^3-3nxyz, then n is a cubic residue of A, and the value of the expression cube root of n (mod A) is congruent to (xx-nyz)/(nzz-xy), to (nyy-nxz)/(xx-nyz), and to (nzz-xy)/(yy-xz).
